title: Terms and Conditions
intro: These Terms and Conditions apply to your use of the Zel Auto Rescue website and to any roadside assistance services we provide. By using our website or requesting our services, you agree to these terms.

sections.heading: Our services
paragraphs: Zel Auto Rescue provides roadside assistance in the Dallas–Fort Worth area, including car lockout, jump start, flat tire change, and fuel delivery. Services are subject to technician availability, location, weather, traffic, and safety conditions.

sections.heading: Requesting service
paragraphs: When you request service, you agree to give us accurate information about your location, your vehicle, and the problem. Arrival times we provide are estimates and are not guaranteed.

sections.heading: Vehicle ownership and authorization
paragraphs: You confirm that you own the vehicle or are authorized to request service on it. For lockout services, we may ask for a photo ID and proof of ownership or authorization before or after opening the vehicle. We may refuse service if ownership or authorization cannot be confirmed.

sections.heading: Pricing and payment
paragraphs: Pricing is provided when you request service. Payment is due when the service is completed, unless we agree otherwise. Fuel delivered is charged in addition to the service fee. If you cancel after a technician has been dispatched, a cancellation fee may apply.

sections.heading: Limits of our services
paragraphs: Our services are intended to get you back on the road and are not a replacement for full vehicle repair. A jump start may not fix an underlying battery or electrical problem, and a spare tire is a temporary solution. We may decline or stop a service if we believe it is unsafe to continue.

sections.heading: Your responsibilities
paragraphs: While waiting for and receiving service, you agree to:
items: Stay in a safe location away from traffic
Follow the instructions of our technician
Tell us about any existing damage or known problems with your vehicle
Provide a spare tire for tire change services

sections.heading: Limitation of liability
paragraphs: We perform our services with reasonable care. To the fullest extent permitted by law, Zel Auto Rescue is not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages, or for pre-existing damage or mechanical problems with your vehicle. Our total liability for any claim related to a service is limited to the amount you paid for that service.

sections.heading: Use of our website
paragraphs: The content on this website is for general information only. You may not copy, change, or use it for commercial purposes without our permission. We may update the website at any time without notice.

sections.heading: Governing law
paragraphs: These terms are governed by the laws of the State of Texas, without regard to its conflict of law rules.

sections.heading: Changes to these terms
paragraphs: We may update these Terms and Conditions from time to time. When we do, we will post the updated version on this page and change the effective date above. Continued use of our website or services means you accept the updated terms.
